description: Get a baby's exact age from a birth date - years, months, weeks, days, totals, zodiac sign, birthstone, the current and next milestone, and special-day dates (100 days, first birthday, 1000 days). Use for any 'how old is the baby' question instead of computing it yourself.

birthday.description: The baby's birth date as YYYY-MM-DD (not in the future).

name: get_baby_age
